title: Cemetery group
html: Cemetery group. The cemetery group \mathcal{Z}_n \subset \mathcal{K}_n is the localising subcategory of graded projective KLR modules annihilated by the fibre functor \tau. It acts as a homological pruning filter on the Gröbner–Shirshov reduction engine. A state word that lands in \mathcal{Z}_n is buried: its image under any subsequent observation vanishes, allowing the computation branch to be dropped.
